2 PLAYERS · ERWIN: W A S D + SPACE · BILLY: ARROWS + ENTER

HOW TO PLAY

Last player standing wins! Drop bombs (fuse 2.5s), blow up crates, and trap your rival. Your own bombs can hurt you too. Match time: 3 minutes — if both survive it's a draw.

POWER-UPS: B Bomb Up · F Fire Up · S Speed Up · + Shield (6s)

👻 The GHOST haunts the market: it chases you and kills on touch (a Shield protects you). It cannot pass crates, blocks or bombs. Blow it up with a bomb to make it fade away. It is dormant for the first 4 seconds.

ERWIN (left pad): D-pad + BOMB · keys W A S D + Space
BILLY (right pad): D-pad + BOMB · keys Arrows + Enter

📱↻
Please rotate your device to landscape to play.
